title: Projection comparison for arbitrary acyclic tensor tests
statement: Let f:U→X be a separated etale finite type morphism and A an arbitrary commutative ring. Write E_T for the canonical constant-scalar realization on T and L for transported sum extension on module sheaves over the constant commutative ring sheaves. For every unbounded complex B of such modules on X, there exists a complex Q on U such that B acyclic implies Q acyclic and, for every unbounded A-module valued sheaf complex P on U, Tot(B ⊗ E_X(f_!P)) is isomorphic to L(Tot(Q ⊗ E_U(P))). Tensor products are the actual sheafified products and direct-sum totals with Koszul differential. No K-flatness is assumed for P.

source.place: Tag 0GKF, lemma-f-shriek-projection; its direct-sum totalization expansion

proof.text: Use the explicit restriction to constant scalars and transport along the canonical ring isomorphism. The constant-scalar counit and the ring-transport unit give E D isomorphic to the identity; their other inverse identities give D E isomorphic to the identity. Apply these natural isomorphisms degreewise to B and to the total tensor on U.

Convert the natural tensor comparison of lem-pur-etale-constant-module-tensor to a curried comparison by its component at each pair (M,N); its two naturality equations follow by specializing joint naturality to (id,g) and (f,id) and simplifying the identity tensor maps. Apply the existing additive mapBifunctorComparison, which is invertible because realization is an equivalence and preserves the coproducts defining the total tensor. Identify B with E D B and move the total tensor through realization. Apply signed tensor symmetry, the declared etale_sum_tensor_totalization isomorphism, and signed tensor symmetry again inside extension. Finally move total tensor through realization on U and cancel D E by the degreewise counit. The composite is precisely the required comparison for arbitrary B and P, with no acyclicity, K-flatness or boundedness assumption.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleSum_tensor_test_comparison {U X : Scheme.{u}} (f : U ⟶ X)
    [hf : Etale f] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    (B : CochainComplex (EtaleSumTensorTestModule X A) ℤ) :
    ∀ P : CochainComplex (Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) ℤ,
      Nonempty (etaleSumTensorTestTotal X A B
        ((etaleSumTensorTestRealizationComplex X A).obj
          ((etaleSumTensorTestSheafComplexExtension f hf A).obj P)) ≅
        (etaleSumTensorTestComplexExtension f hf A).obj
          (etaleSumTensorTestTotal U A
            ((etaleSumTensorTestInverseImageComplex f A).obj B)
            ((etaleSumTensorTestRealizationComplex U A).obj P)))
